θαιρός.definition: pivot of a door or gate; axle of a chariot, S.Fr.596

θᾶκος.definition: Ion. and Ep. Ep. also seat; chair of office, Ar.Ra.1515

θαλία.definition: Ion. abundance, good cheer; as pr. n., v. III

θαλλός.definition: young shoot, young branch; palm-leaves, which were plaited into baskets, Gp.10.6.2

θάλψις.definition: warming, fomenting; opp. of seasons, Hp.Aph.3.1; heat, heating property, Gal.18.228

θάμνα.definition: wine from pressed grapes, a local term, Gp.6.13.2; so prob. Herod.6.90

θαψία.definition: deadly carrot, Thapsia garganica, Arist.Pr.864a5, Thphr.HP9.9.1,6, Dsc.4.153, Plin.HN13.124

θάψος.definition: fustic, Rhus Cotinus, used for dyeing yellow, brought from the island of Thapsos, Theoc.2.88, Nic.Al.570: Thphr.Fr.170

θέα.definition: Ion. seeing, looking at; of the mind, contemplation, Pl.R.582c, cf. Arist.Ph.209b20, etc

θεαίτητος.definition: obtained from God, trans. of Samuel, J.AJ5.10.3: as pr. n. in Plato, etc

θεαρός.definition: Dor. for : title of poem by Epich., Ath.9.408d

θέναρ.definition: palm of the hand; ball of the thumb, Ruf.Onom.87, Gal.18 .864

θεός.definition: Boeot. Lacon. , Cypr., Cret. Inscr.Cypr.135.27 H., Leg.Gort.1.1, Dor. also Call.Cer.58; acc. v.l. ib.130; voc. also LXXDe.3.24, Ev.Matt.27.46, PMag.Lond.121.529, etc.; but classical in compd. names, the Deity, in gene…

θεουδής.definition: fearing God, Hom. only in Od., 6.121, 8.576, 9.176; 19.364; . . . . 19.109, cf. MAMA1.171 , etc. Adv. Orph.Fr.169

θέρειος.definition: Sup. very hot, Arat.149, Nic.Th.460.—In Prose is the more common form

θέρμιον.definition: Dim. of Stud.Pal.22.75.11 , Gloss., condemned by Thom.Mag.p.183 R

θέρος.definition: summer-fruits, harvest, crop, Ar.Eq.392, cf. D.53.21, AP11.365.3 : pl., crops, PFlor.150.5 ; the ripe ears, Plu.Fab.2: metaph., A.Pers.822, cf. Ag.1655; . . E.Ba.1026; of a horse's mane, v. I.3; of a youth's beard, Ca…

θέσις.definition: setting, placing; laying down, opp. Pl.Lg.814a; of diggers, plunging of the spade, opp. Gp.2.45.5

θέσμιος.definition: Dor. and Ep. or; agreement, ib.7.3172.165

θέτης.definition: mortgagor, Is.10.24; adoptive father of a child, Did. ap. Harp

θεῦσις.definition: running, coined as etym. of Corn.ND1

θῇος.definition: Dor. for , Callicr. ap. Stob.4.28.17, Euryph. ap. eund.4.39.27

θίξις.definition: touching, Hp.Mul.1.40, Arist.GA751a19; metaph., apprehension of the mind, Plot.5.3.10: pl., Procl.in Prm.p.628S

θνῆσις.definition: mortality, in a plague, Ruf.Fr.69; Stud.Pal.22.338 ; Cat.Cod.Astr.7.126

θοάς.definition: fem. Adj. fleet, swift, prob. in Pi.Fr.107.7

θόασμα.definition: a place for dancing, etc., Orph.H.49.6

θρῆνυς.definition: the seven-foot bench, perh. helmsman's bench or bridge, Il.15.729

θρῖον.definition: fig-leaf, Ar.Ec.707, Sotad.Com.1.27; prov., of empty threats, Ar.V.436

θρόδαξ.definition: Cypr. for Id.:—Dim. Choerob. in An.Ox. 2.218

θρόνωσις.definition: = enthronement of the newly initiated, at the mysteries of the Corybantes, Pl.Euthd.277d

θρόος.definition: Att. noise as of many; murmur of a crowd or assembly, Th.4.66, 8.79, D.H.6.57, etc

θρύαλλον.definition: shower of smuts from a distant bonfire, Vett.Val.345.22

θρωσμός.definition: springing; of ground rising from the plain, Il.10.160, 11.56; A.R.2.823

θυγάτηρ.definition: gen. contr. dat; later, maidservant, slave, Phalar.Ep.142.3. in Ep. in the longer forms, metri gr.]

θύλακος.definition: sack, esp. to carry meal in; sack in which the eggs of the tunny are enveloped, Arist.HA571a14, cf. 552b19

θῦμα.definition: victim, sacrifice, SIG56.31; metaph., of persons, prob. of Clytemnestra, A.Ag.1118 ; Hdn.2.13.5

θύμος.definition: [perh. , warty excrescence, Hp.Alim.17; the thymus gland in the neck or breast of young animals, Ruf.Onom.168, Gal.UP6.4

θυμός.definition: soul, spirit, as the principle of life, feeling and thought, esp. of strong feeling and passion by Pl.Cra.419e I. in physical sense, breath, life, freq. in Hom., Il.6.17, 5.852, 155, 1.205: c. dupl. acc., 6.17; . . 22…

θύος.definition: burnt sacrifice, A.Ag.1409; later in pl., = Hp. ap. Gal.19.104

θυρίς.definition: Dim. of window, Praxill.5; audience-window of the king or high officials in Egypt, UPZ15.7, 16.20, 53.5 , Heraclid.Cum.4

θυρσίων.definition: part of a fish, Ath.7.310e; Lat. tursio , = a dolphin-like fish, Plin.HN9.34

θύρσος.definition: in late Poets with heterocl. pl

θωρηκτής.definition: armed with Il.21.429; armed with stout cuirass, 12.317,15.689

θώς.definition: also prob. jackal, Canis aureus; hunting dog, Lycaon pictus, Opp.C.3.338, al

θώψ.definition: gen. flatterer, false friend, Hdt.3.80; as Adj., fawning speeches, Trag.Adesp.24, Pl.Tht.175e, Ph.2.52

θαάσσω.definition: Ep. form of used only in pres. and impf., sit, Il.9.194, cf. 15.124; . . Od.3.336, cf. h.Merc.172; ib.468

θαλασσίζω.definition: resemble sea-water, Diph.Siph. ap; wash in sea-water, PHolm.17.2

θαλέθω.definition: poet. for , bloom, thrive, used by Hom. only in part., . . Od.23.191, cf. Ibyc.1.6, A.R.2.843; Emp.20.3; of men, Od.6.63; IG14.1363; AP11.374 ; Lyr.Adesp.98 ; swelling, wantoning in fat, Il.9.467, cf. 23.32: c. acc., …

θάλλω.definition: Hes.Op.173, h.Cer.402, etc.: aor.1; of other natural objects, copious dew, Od.13.245; rich with fat, Il.9.208, cf. Od.13.410; at a sumptuous feast, 11.415

θαλπιάω.definition: to be or become warm, right warm and comfortable, Od.19.319, cf. Arat.1073

θάλπος.definition: warmth, heat, esp. summer-heat, opp; metaph., sting, smart, S.Ant.1086; of love, AP6.207

θάλπω.definition: fut. Orph.Fr.258, Alciphr.2.4: fut. Med. in; heat, warm, without any notion of softening, S.Ant.417; Ar.Av.1092; keep warm, Trag.Adesp.7: prov., of an idle life, Herod.1.37; Id.7.48; ib.129:—Pass., Hp.Aff.4; to be war…

θαμβέω.definition: to be astounded; c. acc., to be astonished at, Od.2.155, cf. 16.178; Pi.N.3.50; A.Supp.570 : in late Prose, Plu.Aem.34

θάμβος.definition: also Simon.237, LXXEc.12.5; in objective sense, terrors in the way, LXX l.c.; object of wonder, Epigr.Gr.1068

θαμίζω.definition: to be accustomed: c.part., he was not wont to be so cared for, Od.8.451; we do not often see you coming down, Pl.R.328c; mourns constantly, S.OC672 : abs., by dint of repetition, Pl.Lg.843b

θανατάω.definition: Desiderat. of desire to die; to be moribund, Ph.2.505, Lyd.Mag.3.40, v.l. in 45

θάπτω.definition: fut. Is.8.21:—Pass., fut. E.Alc.632, Lys.13.45, also S.Aj.577, 1141, E.IT1464: aor. 1 Simon.167 , Hdt.2.81,7.228; more freq.aor. 2 Id.3.10, 55, and always in Att., as Ar.Pl.556; part. CIG2839 : pf. Ion.3pl. v.l. Hdt.6…

θαρσέω.definition: abs., Il.l.c., etc.; fear not! 4.184, A.Supp.732, etc.; ib.600,910; Sopat.14; Ar.Pl.328, al.:—in Epitaphs, . . CIG5200b , etc.: part. in an adverb. sense, with good courage, Il.1.85, cf. A.Ch.666; Id.Ag.1671, cf. Pr.9…

θαυμάζω.definition: Ion. Att. fut. A.Pr.476; abs., wonder, marvel, Il.24.394, Pl.Hp.Ma.282e, etc

θαυμαίνω.definition: Ep. fut. = 2, admire; abs., wonder, , . . Archyt. ap. eund.3.1.114

θεάομαι.definition: Ep. and Ion. , Dor; of the mind, contemplate, Pl.Phd.84b, al

θεηγόρος.definition: one who discourses of God, Id.p.83 B.; but, inspired by God, Hld.2.4; spoken by a goddess, Orph.A.541

θειάζω.definition: to be inspired, frenzied; worship as divine, Id.59.27; Dam.Isid.36:—Pass., Max.Tyr.8.9

θείνω.definition: Ep. inf. Od.22.443: impf; intr., of corpses, Id.Pers.966

θειόω.definition: Ep. fumigate with brimstone; purify, hallow, . . dub. in E.Hel.866

θέλγω.definition: Ion. impf. Od.3.264: fut; c. inf., will persuade her not to kill, A.Pr.865; . . S.Tr.355; Ael.NA10.14

θεμέλιος.definition: of or for the foundation; building-sites, Ptol.Tetr.174, cf. Vett.Val.82.24,al

θεμιστεύω.definition: declare law and right, c. dat; give by way of answer or oracle, h.Ap.253, cf. Lys.Fr.23S.: abs., deliver oracles, E.Ion371, D.S.5.67, Plu.Alex.14; Orac. ap. Ael.VH3.43; cf

θεμόω.definition: only in phrase . . drove the ship ashore, stranded her, Od.9.486; but in ib.542, drove her landwards, i.e. towards her destination: cf. Hsch., who also has

θεοθρέμμων.definition: gen. maintained by God, Orae. ap. Procl.in Alc.p.56C

θεοκόλος.definition: = servant of a god, priest, SIG684.1 , 1021.3 :—hence serve as a priest, IG9.1066 :—also ib.417

θεολογία.definition: science of things divine, Pl.R.379a; oration in praise of a god, SIG1109.115

θεολόγος.definition: one who discourses of the gods, of; theologian: = Moses, Ph.2.152, 416

θεομαχία.definition: battle of the gods, Pl.R.378d , cf; fighting against God, Arr.Epict.3.24.24

θεομήστωρ.definition: like the gods in counsel; Pass., devised by God, Alex.Eph. ap. Theo Sm.p.141H. ; Man.4.7

θεομήτωρ.definition: mother of a god, of Olympias, mother of Alexander, Anon.Hist. p.826J

θεόμορος.definition: destined by the gods, imparted by them; blessed by the gods, Id.P.5.5

θεομυθία.definition: divine lore, mythology, Procl.Theol.Plat.1.4: in pl., Herm.in Phdr.p.73A., Marin.Procl.27

θεοποιέω.definition: make into gods, deify, D.H.2.56; make divine, Hierocl.inCA Praef.p.417M

θεοποιΐα.definition: making of gods, Porph.Abst.4.9; of their; being made divine, Hierocl.in CA27p.483M

θεόπομπος.definition: pr. n. :hence, Adj. , Cretic pentameter used by Theopomp.Com., Heph.13.5

θεοπροπέω.definition: prophesy, but only in part. masc; to be a II, in Boeot. form IG7.3207

θεοσοφέω.definition: have knowledge of things divine, Porph.Abst.4.17

θεουργός.definition: divine worker, of the; performer of sacramental rites, Jul.Or.5.173a, Procl.in Alc.p.150C., Iamb.Myst.3.18

θεόφορος.definition: bearing or carrying; possessed by a god, inspired, the pains of inspiration, Id.Ag.1150 , cf. Phld.D.1.4

θεοφραδής.definition: speaking from God, prophetic; Pass., indicated by God, Procl.H.6.8

θεόφρων.definition: gen. godly-minded, holy, ThebaïsFr.2.3, cf. Pi.O.6.41

θεόω.definition: make into God, deify, Oenom. ap; become divine, Call.Dian.159; Procl.in Prm.p.490S., ct. Jul.Or.5.178b

θεραπεύω.definition: later also , fut; do service to the gods, Hes.Op.135, Hdt.2.37, X.Mem.1.4.13, etc.; Pi.P.3.109; E.Ba.82 , IT1105 ; serve them, Id.Ion111 : abs., worship, Lys.6.51; do service or honour to one's parents, E.Ion183 , Pl.…

θερείω.definition: later poet. form of in Med., Nic.Th.124, Al.567

θερμαίνω.definition: aor. Il.14.7, etc., later; metaph., Pi.O.10.87; E.Alc.758; Id.Cyc.424; Ar.Ra.844; is prob. f.l. for A.Ch.990; Herod.1.20:—Pass., glows with hope, S.Aj.478; have one's heart warm with joy, E.El.402

θέρμω.definition: heat, make hot, only in pres. or impf. forms, Od.8.426, Ar.Ra.1339:—Pass., grow hot, Od.8.437, Il.18.348; . . 23.381; Call.Fr.anon.24; Opp.H.3.522

θέρω.definition: of things, become warm, Heraclit.126, cf. Archel. ap. Plu.2.954f; . . be burnt by fire, Il.6.331, cf. 11.667; melt, AP12.61

θέσφατος.definition: spoken by God, decreed; generally, wonderful, mighty, Od.7.143.—Cf

θέω.definition: Ep. also Il.6.507, 10.437 (in Att. the; to run for a tripod, 11.701: metaph. , they were running for Hector's life, 22.161; ib.74; Paus.6.18.3

θεωρίς.definition: sacred ship, which carried the to their destination, Hdt.6.87, cf. Call.Del.314: metaph., of Charon's bark, A.Th.858

θήγω.definition: Dor. Ar.Lys.1256: fut. E.Cyc.242; metaph., sharpen, excite, Pi.O.10.20; Babr.Prooem.2.14; provoke, X.Cyr.2.1.20, cf. 1.2.10 , Mem.3.3.7; A.Th.715; sharp, biting words. Id.Pr.313; S.Aj.584; E.Or.1625; Alcid. ap.Arist.R…

θηητήρ.definition: Ion. for one who gazes at, an admirer, Od.21.397; Perict. ap. Stob.4.28.19

θηλέω.definition: Dor. Ep. impf. Od.5.73: fut; abs., grow luxuriantly, flourish, A.R.3.221, APl.c.; of a child, IG14.1971; prob. for Epigr. ap. Plu.2.110b

θηρεύτωρ.definition: hunter, of men engaged in Circus games, IG4.365

θηριόω.definition: make into a wild beast; Pass., come to the full size of a beast, Eub.107.14

θηρονόμος.definition: feeding or tending wild beasts, of a; guiding them, Nonn.D.11.122

θητεία.definition: hired service, service, S.OT1029; servility, sycophancy, c. gen., Epicur.Sent.Vat.67

θητεύω.definition: to be a serf or labourer, . . Il.21.444, cf. Od.18.357; 11.489, cf. E.Alc.6, Cyc.77 , Pl.Euthphr.4c, R.359d, Phld.Piet.63; Hdt.8.137; labour at it, Philostr.Her.12a.3; serve, AP5.292.12

θιασεύω.definition: initiate into the Epic.Alex.Adesp; celebrate Bacchic rites, Str.12.4.3

θίασος.definition: Bacchic revel, rout; religious guild, confraternity, IG2.986, 1663, 22.1177, SIG1044.45 , etc

θλάττω.definition: late form of sq., f.l. in Gal.UP10.6, cf. Paul.Aeg.6.91

θλίβω.definition: Ar.Pax1239, etc.: fut; compress, straiten, Pl.Ti.60c; reduce, compress, Epicur.Ep.1p.16U.:—Pass., to be compressed, Pl.Ti.91a; Archim.Fluit.1 Prooem.; a small, close hut, Theoc.21.18; opp. Ev.Matt.7.14; a scanty subsi…

θοάζω.definition: ) trans., move quickly, ply; intr., move quickly, rush, dart, Id.Or.1542; Id.Ba.219; Id.Tr.307; Id.Fr.145. .)

θοινατήρ.definition: one who gives a feast, lord of a horrid feast, A.Ag.1502

θοινάω.definition: feast on, eat, dub.l; Pass., to be feasted upon, i.e. sacrificed, IG12.905

θολός.definition: mud, dirt, esp. in water, Arist.Fr.311; menses, Orph.L.490

θολόω.definition: make turbid, prop. of water, of the; metaph., E.Alc.1067; confounded by joy, Pherecr.115; Philostr.VA8.7; . . Procop.Goth.4.19

θόλωσις.definition: making turbid, troubling, esp. of water, Arist.PA679a7; also Gal.16.609

θοόω.definition: make sharp or pointed, Od.9.327; metaph., in Pass., Hermesian.7.11; Opp.H.1.557, 2.525

θορυβέω.definition: make a noise, uproar or disturbance, esp. of; shout in token of approbation or the contrary

θόρυβος.definition: noise, esp. the confused noise of a; esp. in token of approbation or the contrary, Pl.R.492b, 492c

θράσσω.definition: Att. pres. part. neut; disturb, destroy, APl.4.255

θρεπτέος.definition: to be fed, nurtured, metaph; one must feed, keep, Id.Ti.19a, X.Lac.9.5

θρηνέω.definition: fut. A.Ag.1541 , S.Aj.632; c.acc., bewail, A.Pr.615; Pl.Phd.85a; . . S.El.94 , cf. 530, Ev.Luc.23.27, etc.; E.Fr.449:—so also Med., A.Pr.43:—Pass., to be lamented, S.Aj.852, Fr.653

θριγκός.definition: topmost course of stones in a wall; metaph., coping-stone, last finish, E.Tr.489; . . Pl.R.534e

θρίσσω.definition: = Ar.Byz. ap.Erot.; Ion.acc. to Greg.Cor.p.571 S

θρόμβωσις.definition: becoming curdled; blocked vein, thrombosis, Cael.Aur.TP4.40

θρόνιον.definition: Dim. of EM456.28; part of the constellation Cassiopea, Ptol.Alm.8.2

θρυλιγμός.definition: or unmusical sound, false note, D.H.Comp.11; Porph.in Harm.p.204 W

θρῴσκω.definition: folld. by Prep., leap upon, assault, Il.8.252, cf. 15.380; A.R.1.1296; E.Or.257 ; of a recurring illness, attack, S.Tr.1028

θύημα.definition: = foreg., in pl., Tim.Lex.:= Hp. ap. Erot

θυμέλη.definition: prop.place of burning, hearth; esp. of the altar of Dionysus which stood in the orchestra of the theatre, Pratin.Lyr.1.2, cf.EM743.37, etc.: hence in later writers

θυμοειδής.definition: high-spirited, Hp.Aër.12; opp; passionate, hot-tempered, opp. ib.375c

θυνέω.definition: = only impf., dart along, Hes.Sc.[210]; ib.156, cf. 257; ib.286, cf. eund.Cat.Oxy.1358Fr.2.20

θυννάζω.definition: spear a tunny-fish, strike with a harpoon, metaph., Ar.V.1087

θυνναῖος.definition: = an offering of the first tunny-fish caught, Antig. Car. ap. Ath.7.297e

θύνω.definition: only pres. and impf., = rush, dart

θυοσκοπία.definition: = haruspicina, used as etym. of Lyd.Mag.Prooem

θυόω.definition: fill with sweet smells: pf. part. Pass. fragrant oil, Il.14.172; CypriaFr.4, cj. in h.Ap.184; Call.Lav.Pall.63: aor. part. Hedyl. ap. Ath.11.486b.— Ep. word

θυρσάζω.definition: bear or brandish the thyrsus, Lacon. part. gen. pl. fem. for Ar.Lys.1313

θύρωμα.definition: doorway (including posts, sill; panel, tablet, Diotog. ap. Stob.4.1.96; Archyt. ap. eund.4.1.138

θυσία.definition: Ion. prop. burnt-offering; mode of sacrifice, Hdt.4.60, cf. 2.39

θυτήρ.definition: sacrificer, slayer, A.Ag.224,240 , S.Tr.613, al.: coupled with Call.Iamb.1.221

θύω.definition: impf. Ep. Od.15.222, Ion; Act., offer by burning meat or drink to the gods , . . , Il.9.219, cf. Aristarch. ap. Sch.ad loc., Com.Adesp.7D. ; of a drink-offering, Od.14.446, cf. 15.260; so made an offering of cheese, 9…

θύωμα.definition: that which is burnt as incense: pl., spices, Heraclit.67, Semon.16, Hdt.2.40,86, Luc.Syr.D.20

θωρήσσω.definition: fortify with drink, Hp.Epid.2.5.10; Nic.Al.32; Ruf. ap. Orib.6.38.23; make drunk, intoxicate, Thgn.842:—Med. and Pass., get drunk, Id.470: abs., Id.413, Pi.Fr.72; Hp.Morb.4.56, cf. Duris27 J

θατέρως.definition: Adv. in the other way, Simp.in Ph.210.10

θειόθεν.definition: Adv., I.4) from the Emperor, Just.Nov.82.9

θην.definition: enclit. Particle chiefly Ep. and Dor., rare in Trag., A.Pr.928:—in truth, I ween, freq. ironical, Il.13.620; 17.29, cf. 21.568; strengthd., in very truth, 11.365, 13.813; surely not, 2.276, Od.5.211; 3.352; Il.21.568:…

θύραθι.definition: Adv. at the door, EM25.17:—Ep. outside, I was soon out , Od.14.352
